name: fork-panel-xc/fork-panel-xc
description: Fork Panel XC - Open-source IPTV panel forked from XC_VM. Modern, modular, API-first architecture with Vue 3 frontend.

post-install-cmd: @php -r "fwrite(STDERR, \"[fork-panel-xc] NOTE: vendor/ is committed and shipped. Use 'composer dump-autoload' to regenerate; do not run 'composer install' on the deploy path.\n\");"
post-update-cmd: @php -r "fwrite(STDERR, \"[fork-panel-xc] NOTE: vendor/ + composer.lock are committed. After changing deps, commit composer.lock and re-commit a PRODUCTION-only vendor: composer install --no-dev.\n\");"
